_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): RBAC + admin user management — role on User, require_role dependency, admin-only users router (list/search, set role, activate/deactivate, reset password), env-seeded first admin. Requires feature-auth (User model + role claim in tokens).
name: feature-rbac
description: RBAC + admin user management: require_role guard, users admin API (roles, activation, password reset), env-seeded first admin.

variables.name: app_name
variables.description: Python package name, e.g. 'app' or 'demo_admin' (must match feature-auth's)

notes: Requires feature-auth: the User model carries the role column and login tokens carry the role claim. After applying: 1) app.include_router(router), 2) seed the first admin at startup (ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env — see TODO in the router), 3) protect admin-only resources with Depends(require_role('admin')). Frontend: manage users with comp-crud-page pointing at {base_path}/admin/users (role column uses comp-form's select field).
